summary: DBV Technologies S.A., a French clinical-stage biopharma listed on Nasdaq via ADSs (each representing five ordinary shares), filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing a September 29, 2026 press release announcing submission of a Biologics License Application to the U.S. FDA for its VIASKIN Peanut Patch in children aged 4-7 with peanut allergy. The company requested Priority Review; the FDA previously granted Breakthrough Therapy Designation. The BLA is supported by the Phase 3 VITESSE trial. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors are referenced. This is a routine regulatory milestone, not a special situation; watch FDA review timing and acceptance.
